name: analyze-prime-numbers
description: Analyze prime numbers using primality tests, factorization algorithms, prime distribution analysis, and sieve methods. Covers trial division, Miller-Rabin, Sieve of Eratosthenes, and the Prime Number Theorem. Use when determining whether an integer is prime or composite, finding prime factorizations, counting or listing primes up to a bound, or investigating prime properties within a number-theoretic proof or computation.
